# Hemsethu Technologies

> Engineering Excellence. Bridging the gap between university curriculum and the demands of the modern technology industry.

## About
Founded by passionate engineers, HemSethu Technologies (HEM - Hub of Emerging Minds. Sethu - The Bridge to Technology) is a recognized digital innovation hub based in Secunderabad. We offer project-based, hands-on learning environments directly aligned with industry needs.

## Services
- **Academic & IEEE Projects**: Fully customizable source code, database schemas, and documentation (SRS, DFD) for engineering students.
- **Enterprise Bootcamps**: Intensive training in React, Django, Full-Stack, and UI/UX.
- **Internships**: Remote and on-site software engineering and digital marketing internships.
- **Publication Support**: Guidance for IEEE, UGC Care, and Scopus journal publications.
